title: Repeat-Violation Charge Posting — Community Rules & Site Care Resident Desk Card
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, a repeat-violation charge is assessed once the repeat notice has its outcome recorded; it is assessed for the violation notice most recently served on the plan record, dated the day that notice was served, referenced to it and carrying its violation sequence. The resident desk posts it on the plan record's rules and site-care statement.

The repeat-violation charge on a notice is fixed only once each community cure on the plan record has its self-help charge posted.

## What the posting does

`post_repeat_violation_charge_7b5daab9` adds one repeat-violation charge, referenced to the repeat notice and carrying that notice's place in its class sequence, to the statement of the named plan record, and raises the record's statement balance by the amount. The resident sees the charge, dated the day the notice was served, on their rules and site-care statement.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the representative first unlocks `post_repeat_violation_charge_7b5daab9` and then calls it on the resident desk's behalf. One call posts the charge for one repeat notice.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rules_plan_id` | the reference number of the site-care plan record whose statement is charged, as returned by the site-care plan record lookup for the resident | identifier |
| `source_record_id` | the reference number of the repeat violation notice charged, as returned by the rules records lookup for the plan record | identifier |
| `entry_date` | the date the repeat notice was served | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date, no time of day, no time zone |
| `violation_sequence` | the notice's place among the notices of its rule class in the window | whole positive integer |
| `amount` | the repeat-violation charge, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with status `posted`, showing the statement reference of the new charge, the plan record charged, the repeat notice, the date it was served, its violation sequence, the amount, and the statement balance once the charge is on it. The tool defines no other outcome.
